name: Temporal information loss with intermittent blood pressure display: a retrospective intraoperative study with cross-database technical replication: reproducibility package
description: Analysis source code, frozen analysis rules, aggregate results, scientific figures and a 25-worksheet results workbook for intermittent blood pressure display in VitalDB, with technical replication using MIMIC-IV Waveform v0.1.0 and SICdb v1.0.8. This version adds source-resolution bridging, patient-equal summaries, event-feature strata, objective onset sensitivities, distinct-recovery analyses and common-valid-time comparisons. It preserves differing directions across scenarios. It contains no raw datasets, patient-level derivatives or manuscript files. Full statistical recomputation requires independently authorised source data and local caches. Release validation is distinguished from the earlier source-data analyses; a new clean-room raw-to-results run is not claimed.
